messages.author: 37d8f1992a4f263b
messages.subject: Cannot Get Model to Compile
parts:
Hi,

I'm new to NIMBLE and thought I'd try to code up a simple mixed model to get a feel for how NIMBLE works. I thought it'd be fun to use the data / modified model from Piepho & Ogutu (2002), which can be fit using lmer from lme4 (so it seemed like a good place to start). However, I couldn't get the model to compile and there was a warning message issued when the nimbleModel function was called. A MWE is provided in the attached ZIP folder (I'm using a Windows 10 OS).

I'm probably doing something dumb, but can't spot it at the moment. I was hoping a fresh set of eyes could get me going in the right direction.

Thanks!

Josh

messages.author: 9b1f1220a2b07d1e
messages.subject: Re: Cannot Get Model to Compile
parts:
Hi Josh,

I think the issue you're having is due to two small problems with easy fixes.

First, any data that's used for indexing--in this case, "site" and "year" vectors--needs to be provided in "constants." This will clear that super long warning about dynamic indices.

Second, in your custom NIMBLE function, your arguments look like they need "= double(0)" (scalar) instead of "= double(1)" vector.

Fixing these two should let you compile the model.

Ben
